title: {{NAME}} and the Princess's Lost Crown
moral: True friends help each other, no matter what.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} lived near a big, shiny castle.
The castle had tall pink towers.
Animals roamed the green fields nearby.
A small deer ran up to {{NAME}}.
"The princess needs help!" said the deer.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} ran to the castle gate.
Princess Lara stood there, crying a little.
She wore a pink dress with gold stars.
"My crown fell into the old cave," she said.
{{NAME}}'s eyes went wide. A cave!

pages.content:
They ran to the dark cave together.
Inside, a friendly dinosaur was sitting down.
He had the crown on his big head!
He did not know it was hers.
{{NAME}} waved his arms and called out loud.

pages.content:
The dinosaur looked up and blinked.
He felt the crown on his head.
He began to laugh a big, deep laugh.
He gently gave the crown back.
Princess Lara held it tight to her chest.

pages.content:
The princess put her crown back on.
She smiled at {{NAME}} and the dinosaur.
"Thank you, dear friends," she said.
The little deer danced in the soft grass.
{{NAME}} felt proud and happy and sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the dinosaur wants to show you a secret room in the castle.
